component.name: GlitchVape
component.summary: Apply VHS, CRT and databending effects to photographs

description.p: GlitchVape puts a photograph through a signal chain of thirty-nine effects: tape wobble and tracking error, chromatic aberration, pixel sorting and databending, film grain, scanlines and phosphor grilles, and the text and furniture that sit over the top.
Order is not a free choice, so effects declare where in the chain they belong and the pipeline sorts by it. Presets bundle a whole look, and a render can be reproduced exactly from its seed.

The window is a front end rather than a second implementation: its controls are generated from the same declarations that drive the command line, and Export goes through the same code path, so a saved image is identical to the equivalent invocation of the CLI.
Adding an effect is now a three-page assistant with a live preview, and the effect categories have been renamed to say what they are.
